svg.title: How it works
svg.desc: The webcam, or the play pad and keys, feeds MediaPipe HandLandmarker, which finds 21 points on each of two hands. Pure gesture maths turns them into a pinch value, a turn value and drum taps. Tone.js plays the vocal, the bass, the drum samples and the looper to the speakers, and a recorder can capture the output. A Three.js scene and the music player follow the same values.
